CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION crowd_v4.acceptance_task_input(t crowd_v4.tasks)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select to_jsonb(t)-array['target','received','status','claimed_by','lease_token','lease_until','available_at','last_claimed_at','lease_start_received'];
$function$
